item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00218","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C05","C02","C25"],"selected_candidate_label":"C05","confidence":0.78,"relationship_type":"structural_functional_template","rationale":"C05 plausibly supplied the personnel-letter template used by the child: acknowledge the official's request, express reluctance, affirm and praise the official's qualities and service, explain why the requested adverse personnel action must nevertheless be taken, and close with gratitude and good wishes. C02 has a notable parallel assurance that a personnel decision reflects no loss of confidence, while C25 similarly combines regret, acceptance of a resignation, and praise, but neither matches the child's full progression as closely as C05.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"It is with the deepest regret that I yield to your request to withdraw my nomination of you","parent_excerpt":"Because of those urgent personal considerations about which you have spoken to me so many times, I accept your resignation... Although I take this action reluctantly","explanation":"Both open or culminate in reluctant acceptance of a personnel action requested by the recipient."},{"child_excerpt":"I want you to know that my faith in you is undiminished. From experience, I know the qualities of integrity, industry and high intelligence that you would have brought to the position","parent_excerpt":"Your entire service has been characterized by vision, foresight, and a broad appreciation... Your competent service has been a major contribution","explanation":"Both interrupt the adverse personnel action with an extended affirmation of the recipient's abilities and public service."},{"child_excerpt":"With deep appreciation of the fine spirit which prompted your request","parent_excerpt":"For all that you have done in your country's behalf... I tender you heartfelt assurance of my gratitude and appreciation","explanation":"Both close by converting the reluctant personnel decision into an expression of personal gratitude and appreciation."}]}
